primitives.name: target_acquire
primitives.purpose: Resolve a target and establish a trackable location.
primitives.visual: Target marker resolves from an uncertain trace.

primitives.name: target_move
primitives.purpose: Move an acquired target through bounded scene anchors.
primitives.visual: Target travels laterally while trackers adjust.

primitives.name: target_escape
primitives.purpose: Break the current trace and overshoot trackers.
primitives.visual: Target exits the trace field and tracking lines miss.

primitives.name: target_reacquire
primitives.purpose: Resolve the escaped target at a new bounded location.
primitives.visual: Target reappears away from its prior position.

primitives.name: tracker_converge
primitives.purpose: Converge multiple tracking traces on a resolved target.
primitives.visual: Independent trackers correct course toward one point.

primitives.name: target_lock
primitives.purpose: Commit a stable target lock after acquisition.
primitives.visual: Lock brackets close around the target.

primitives.name: fragment_spawn
primitives.visual: Separated data pieces appear across the chamber.

primitives.name: fragment_drift
primitives.purpose: Move fragments through deterministic spatial drift.
primitives.visual: Fragments drift inward without random choreography.

primitives.name: fragment_align
primitives.purpose: Align fragments into a coherent record grid.
primitives.visual: Pieces settle into bounded rows and columns.

primitives.name: record_reconstruct
primitives.purpose: Resolve aligned fragments into one recovered record.
primitives.visual: The fragmented field consolidates into a coherent screen.

primitives.name: connection_attempt
primitives.purpose: Attempt a link between isolated nodes.
primitives.visual: An incomplete segmented link searches between nodes.

primitives.name: signal_travel
primitives.purpose: Move visible packets through an attempted connection.
primitives.visual: Packets visibly cross the scene rather than flashing.

primitives.name: bridge_form
primitives.purpose: Convert an attempted link into a continuous bridge.
primitives.visual: Broken segments join into one continuous path.

primitives.name: bridge_stabilize
primitives.purpose: Stabilize a formed bridge and propagate downstream response.
primitives.visual: Bridge thickens and wall cells respond in sequence.

primitives.name: path_override
primitives.purpose: Inject a foreign control signal into an existing route.
primitives.visual: A warm intrusion travels into the normal circuit system.

primitives.name: network_reroute
primitives.purpose: Move additional paths onto the overridden route.
primitives.visual: Independent paths change color and flow toward new control.

primitives.name: anomaly_seed
primitives.visual: One node enters a visible warning state.

primitives.name: cascade_failure
primitives.purpose: Propagate ordered failures while preserving one survivor path.
primitives.visual: Nodes fail progressively and one route remains active.

openings.name: cold_open_active_record
openings.behavior: Begin on an already live coherent record.

openings.name: signal_intrusion
openings.behavior: Begin with a foreign signal entering from a scene edge.

openings.name: slow_system_wake
openings.behavior: Wake sparse wall cells and circuits before projection.

openings.name: target_already_moving
openings.behavior: Begin with the primary target in motion.

openings.name: corrupt_record_resolve
openings.behavior: Begin on separated fragments moving toward order.

openings.name: warning_state_open
openings.behavior: Begin with one bounded warning state already active.

openings.name: single_cell_propagation
openings.behavior: Begin at one wall cell and propagate outward.

openings.name: follow_energy_packet
openings.behavior: Begin close on one packet and follow it to the hub.

openings.name: network_overload_open
openings.behavior: Begin on loaded paths before controlled failure.

openings.name: projection_from_darkness
openings.behavior: Materialize the record from a dark chamber.

cameras.name: slow_push
cameras.behavior: Bounded gradual push toward the primary action.

cameras.name: pull_back
cameras.behavior: Bounded reveal from close framing to the full system.

cameras.name: lateral_track
cameras.behavior: Track activity laterally within safe bounds.

cameras.name: follow_packet
cameras.behavior: Follow a moving signal between bounded anchors.

cameras.name: orbit_subtle
cameras.behavior: Small deterministic orbital drift around the system.

cameras.name: close_to_wide
cameras.behavior: Reveal system context from a close detail.

cameras.name: wide_to_close
cameras.behavior: Resolve from system scale into one record detail.

cameras.name: reveal_from_detail
cameras.behavior: Begin enlarged and settle into readable full composition.
